title: Buddy Bolden: loudest trumpeter, hall player, poisoned trumpet story
summary: Bolden was a very loud, popular hall player who never worked the district; Amacker has heard he died from a poisoned trumpet.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends
